# lancha boat

> Private boat charters aboard *Quarters* on Lake Michigan in Chicago. Morning, afternoon, and night charters departing from Diversey Harbor. Operated as a bareboat / demise charter: lancha boat lines up a USCG-licensed captain; guests bring their own food and drinks.

## Key facts
- Boat: Quarters, docked at Diversey Harbor, K-Dock Slip 8, Chicago, IL
- Time blocks: Morning 10:00 AM–2:00 PM · Afternoon 2:30–6:30 PM · Night 7:00–11:00 PM (each a 4-hour private charter)
- Captain: a USCG-licensed captain is required; typically $100–$150/hr, arranged separately. Guests may bring their own qualified captain.
- Fuel: flat $25 if the trip stays at the Playpen, otherwise $25/hr of engine time, invoiced after the trip.
- Booking: online with live calendar availability; open slots auto-confirm.
- Contact: lalanchacharters@gmail.com

## Destinations
- [The Playpen](/where-we-go/playpen): Chicago's legendary boat-party anchorage off Ohio Street Beach (top pick).
- [South Loop & Museum Campus](/where-we-go/south-loop): the cleanest head-on view of the Chicago skyline.
- [Navy Pier](/where-we-go/navy-pier): the iconic pier, plus summer fireworks (Wednesdays & Saturdays) from the water.
- [Burnham Harbor & Northerly Island](/where-we-go/burnham): calmer, protected water with skyline and Museum Campus views.
- [The Chicago River](/where-we-go/the-river): an up-close architecture cruise on calm water — the most family-friendly route.
